verdict.rationale: Databricks publishes a dedicated vendor doc page explaining what dbt is, how to install dbt Core, and how to connect it to Databricks (databricks-docs-10, -14, -35), making dbt a documented first-class integration path for data engineers. missing for 10: no evidence of a native dbt-Databricks adapter maintenance/versioning details, no independent/hands-on confirmation of the integration's reliability, and no mention of dbt Cloud-specific Databricks support.
